name: Sano Fumiya
source:
The school nurse/health teacher at the protagonist's school.
He thinks of everything is as simple as cutting bamboo, a very gentlemanly person.
He has a floaty atmosphere and a peculiar glamour, boys and girl alike are taken with him.
He has a rule to accept all those who come to him and to not chase away the ones who leave.
His flower is the Lotus.
